prompt: Every visitor downloads the admin dashboard code, which only 0.1% of users ever open.
tells: Every visitor downloads the admin dashboard code
why: Split it into its own chunk, loaded only on the admin route.
trap: It's one rarely used feature, not a mostly static page.

prompt: A rich-text editor library is 300 KB but only needed when a user clicks "Write a review".
tells: only needed when a user clicks
trap: The editor runs on the main thread fine; the cost is downloading it up front.

prompt: A single-page app ships one 2 MB bundle for all 30 routes, and the landing page is slow on phones.
tells: one 2 MB bundle for all 30 routes
why: Split per route so the landing page loads only its own code.
trap: Server rendering helps first paint but still ships 2 MB.

prompt: After splitting by route, clicking to checkout now pauses while its chunk downloads.
why: Prefetch likely next chunks on hover or when idle.
trap: Splitting trades size for latency; prefetch wins it back.

prompt: A 400 KB charting library is imported by the app's entry file, but charts only appear on the Reports page.
tells: imported by the app's entry file
only appear on the Reports page
why: Import it dynamically on the Reports route.
trap: Moving the import is the fix; the library isn't the problem.

prompt: A rarely opened "Export settings" modal pulls in a large date-picker library on every page load.
why: Lazy-load the modal and its dependencies when opened.
trap: Rare features shouldn't cost every visitor.

prompt: Every deploy changes the single bundle's hash, so returning users redownload unchanged libraries.
why: Split stable vendor code into its own chunk so it stays cached across deploys.
trap: Splitting helps caching, not just first load.

prompt: Modern browsers download polyfills only old browsers need.
tells: download polyfills only old browsers need
why: Load polyfills conditionally (or serve differential bundles).
trap: Ship code only to those who need it.
